content.title: Ukraine's President Zelensky Criticizes US for Calling Putin a Friend
content.caption: Volodymyr Zelensky, Ukraine's president, criticizes the US for calling Vladimir Putin a friend and delays in delivering vital anti-ballistic missiles.
